# Flow > Node graph editor parts that skin React Flow with Control UI tokens. Status: experimental. This file matches the installed `flow` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/flow.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/flow.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@xyflow/react@^13.0.3` - `lucide-react@^1.78.0` ## Registry dependencies - `button` - `canvas-grid` - `core` - `motion` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/flow-knobs`: `flowKnobs`, types `FlowKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/flow`: `Flow`, `FlowBackground`, `FlowPanel`, `FlowControls`, `FlowNode`, `FlowNodeHeader`, `FlowNodeBody`, `FlowHandle`, `FlowEdge`, `FlowEdgeLabel`, `FlowEdgeLabelChip`, types `FlowProps`, `FlowBackgroundProps`, `FlowPanelProps`, `FlowControlsProps`, `FlowNodeProps`, `FlowNodePartProps`, `FlowHandleProps`, `FlowEdgeProps`, `FlowEdgeLabelProps`, `FlowEdgeLabelChipProps` ## Composition ### Node graph ```tsx toolbar custom node type custom edge type ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { type Edge, type EdgeProps, type EdgeTypes, getBezierPath, type Node, type NodeProps, type NodeTypes, Position, } from "@xyflow/react"; import { Flow, FlowBackground, FlowControls, FlowEdge, FlowEdgeLabel, FlowEdgeLabelChip, FlowHandle, FlowNode, FlowNodeBody, FlowNodeHeader, } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/flow"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; type StepNode = Node<{ title: string; detail: string }, "step">; type StepEdge = Edge<{ label?: string; dashed?: boolean }, "step">; function StepNodeCard({ data, selected }: NodeProps) { return ( {data.title} {data.detail} ); } function StepEdgePath({ data, ...edge }: EdgeProps) { const [path, labelX, labelY] = getBezierPath(edge); return ( <> {data?.label ? ( {data.label} ) : null} ); } const nodeTypes: NodeTypes = { step: StepNodeCard }; const edgeTypes: EdgeTypes = { step: StepEdgePath }; const nodes: StepNode[] = [ { id: "trigger", type: "step", position: { x: 160, y: 0 }, data: { title: "New ticket", detail: "Support inbox webhook" } }, { id: "classify", type: "step", position: { x: 160, y: 140 }, data: { title: "Classify intent", detail: "Model call, 3 labels" } }, { id: "refund", type: "step", position: { x: 0, y: 300 }, data: { title: "Draft refund", detail: "Order lookup tool" } }, { id: "answer", type: "step", position: { x: 320, y: 300 }, data: { title: "Search docs", detail: "Retrieval, top 5" } }, { id: "respond", type: "step", position: { x: 160, y: 460 }, data: { title: "Send reply", detail: "Waits for approval" } }, ]; const edges: StepEdge[] = [ { id: "trigger-classify", type: "step", source: "trigger", target: "classify", data: {} }, { id: "classify-refund", type: "step", source: "classify", target: "refund", data: { label: "Billing" } }, { id: "classify-answer", type: "step", source: "classify", target: "answer", data: { label: "How-to" } }, { id: "refund-respond", type: "step", source: "refund", target: "respond", data: {} }, { id: "answer-respond", type: "step", source: "answer", target: "respond", data: { dashed: true } }, ]; const FIT_VIEW_OPTIONS = { padding: "8%" } as const; export function PrimitiveFlowExample() { return (
aria-label="Support agent workflow" defaultNodes={nodes} defaultEdges={edges} nodeTypes={nodeTypes} edgeTypes={edgeTypes} fitView fitViewOptions={FIT_VIEW_OPTIONS} >
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `flow` - `controls` - `edge`: `data-dashed` - `edge-label` - `edge-label-chip` - `handle` - `node`: `data-selected` - `node-body` - `node-header` - `panel` - `root` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### flow - `--cui-flow-background`: `var(--canvas)` - `--cui-flow-grid-dot-color`: `var(--canvas-grid-dot)` - `--cui-flow-edge-stroke`: `oklch(from var(--muted-foreground) l c h / 0.6)` - `--cui-flow-selected-edge-stroke`: `var(--primary)` - `--cui-flow-edge-size`: `1.5px` - `--cui-flow-node-background`: `var(--card)` - `--cui-flow-node-foreground`: `var(--card-foreground)` - `--cui-flow-node-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-flow-node-hover-border-color`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.2)` - `--cui-flow-node-selected-border-color`: `var(--primary)` - `--cui-flow-node-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-flow-node-body-background`: `transparent` - `--cui-flow-node-body-radius`: `0px` - `--cui-flow-node-body-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)` - `--cui-flow-node-body-padding-block`: `0px` - `--cui-flow-node-radius`: `var(--radius-panel)` - `--cui-flow-node-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)` - `--cui-flow-handle-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)` - `--cui-flow-handle-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-flow-handle-border-color`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-flow-handle-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-flow-handle-radius`: `9999px` - `--cui-flow-edge-label-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-flow-edge-label-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-flow-edge-label-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-flow-edge-label-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-flow-edge-label-radius`: `9999px` - `--cui-flow-controls-item-radius`: `min(var(--radius-sm), calc(var(--control-h-sm) / 2))` - `--cui-flow-controls-padding`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 1)` - `--cui-flow-controls-radius`: `calc( var(--cui-flow-controls-item-radius) + clamp(0px, calc(var(--cui-flow-controls-item-radius) * 1000), var(--cui-flow-controls-padding)) )` - `--cui-flow-controls-background`: `var(--card)` - `--cui-flow-controls-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-flow-controls-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/flow - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/flow.json
